scope: Two disposable owned windows reproduced and then verified a native pointer-recipient admission guard in a source-built .39 candidate. The observation covers one target outside the captured foreground window and one scoped correction; it is not a broad input correctness or critical-error benchmark, installed .39 verification, or model/task E2E.

guard_behavior.admission_point: Immediately before pointer button-down and vertical or horizontal wheel input.
guard_behavior.recipient_check: Read the physical cursor position, resolve WindowFromPoint, and require its GA_ROOT ancestor to equal the captured native foreground window.
guard_behavior.release_behavior: Button releases skip recipient and foreground admission so recovery remains independent.
guard_behavior.scope: The two tested windows were both owned fixture windows. No user-application input was sent.

focused_unit_tests.scope: Focused pointer and input tests only; this does not establish full-suite status.

critical_scope_observation.method: One paired disposable-window reproduction and corrected verification.
critical_scope_observation.note: This is not a whole-workload zero-critical-errors or critical-zero release claim.
